description: This file defines the ErrorPage class which extends SimplePage to generate error pages in a documentation system. It includes constants for different error types, uses configuration and templating components, and provides methods for constructing and rendering error pages.

classes.name: ErrorPage
classes.description: A specialized page class for rendering error messages with different error types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an ErrorPage with a title, content, and configuration, initializing the parent SimplePage.

methods.name: generatePage
methods.description: Generates the HTML content of the error page using a template and the provided configuration.
